# Copilot Instructions — dmtools-agents

## Architecture

This is a **generic agents repository** (typically used as a git submodule at `agents/` inside product repos). It orchestrates AI-driven Agile delivery via [dmtools](https://github.com/nicku/dmtools) — a Java tool that provides a GraalJS runtime for agent scripts.

### Execution model

1. **SM Agent** (`sm.json` → `js/smAgent.js`) runs on a cron schedule, queries Jira via JQL rules, and dispatches specialized agents by triggering GitHub Actions workflows.
2. **Agent configs** (root `*.json` files) define individual agent jobs. Three job types exist:
   - `Teammate` — CLI-based agent (prepares context → runs AI CLI → post-processes result)
   - `JSRunner` — pure GraalJS logic executed inside dmtools (no AI CLI)
   - `TestCasesGenerator` — dmtools-native job for test case generation
3. **Project config** lives in the target repo at `.dmtools/config.js`, never here. This repo stays project-agnostic.

### Key layers

| Layer | Location | Purpose |
|-------|----------|---------|
| SM rules | `sm.json`, `sm_merge.json` | JQL-based ticket routing |
| Agent configs | root `*.json` | Job definitions (type, params, actions) |
| JS runtime scripts | `js/` | Pre/post actions, orchestration logic |
| Shared helpers | `js/common/` | SCM abstraction, Jira helpers, PR logic |
| Config system | `js/configLoader.js` + `js/config.js` | Discovery, merging, defaults |
| Prompts | `prompts/` | Markdown entry prompts for CLI agents |
| Instructions | `instructions/` | Reusable instruction packs (review, dev, rework, platform, tracker, scm) |
| Setup scripts | `setup/` | Shell scripts for CI environment setup |

## GraalJS Constraints

All `js/` runtime code executes in **dmtools GraalJS**, not Node.js.

- Use `var` declarations and plain functions (no `let`/`const`, no arrow functions, no async/await, no template literals).
- No Node.js APIs: no `fs`, `path`, `process`, `Buffer`, `child_process`, no npm packages.
- No browser APIs: no `fetch`, `window`, `document`.
- Use dmtools globals: `jira_*`, `github_*`, `ado_*`, `file_read`, `file_write`, `cli_execute_command`.
- Local `require('./module.js')` works only for files within this repo.
- **Requires resolve by execution time** (gh-823): a require that runs while a module initializes (top level, top-level `try`/`if`) resolves **file-relative**; a require that runs **after init** (any lazy/deferred call into an exported function) resolves against the **main script's directory — the pack's `js/` root — exclusively**, and a file-relative hit is never tried. `dmtools compile` discovers the pack closure strictly file-relative. Therefore: **hoist every require to the top of the module — never require lazily.** A lazy sibling-flat spec from `js/common/` looks for `js/x.js` and reds the tick ("Failed to require module"), and a pack-root-relative spec (`./common/…`) authored from a nested file fails the pack build. (Worker-source strings are the one exception — they execute on fresh engines and are authored js-root-relative: `require('./common/smProvider.js')`.) The repo-wide pin in `js/unit-tests/test_packRequirePath.js` fails the suite on ANY deferred require in packed code; its `ALLOWED_DEFERRED` list carries exactly one deliberate entry — `writeSolutionAndDiagrams.js`'s cycle-breaking `require('./writeSolutionAndLabels.js')` (hoisting it would close the labels→diagrams cycle at load time) — don't add a second one.
- Keep data structures JSON-safe.

## Running Tests

Tests run **standalone** inside dmtools GraalJS via the custom test runner. The repo is independent — no parent repo or submodule mount needed.

```bash
# Run from the dmtools-agents repo root
cd dmtools-agents

# All tests
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# Single test suite
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json
```

Each `run_*.json` specifies which test files to load. Tests use `loadModule()` with mock injection — see `js/unit-tests/testRunner.js` for the framework API (`test()`, `suite()`, `assert.*`, `loadModule()`, `makeRequire()`).

### Writing tests for new logic

**All new JS logic must be covered by unit tests before committing.**

- Create or extend a `js/unit-tests/test_<module>.js` file.
- Add it to the corresponding `run_<module>.json` (or create a new one) and include it in `run_all.json`.
- Use `loadModule('js/your-module.js', makeRequire({...}), { globalMock: fn })` to isolate the module.
- Mock all dmtools globals (`file_read`, `file_write`, `cli_execute_command`, `jira_*`, `github_*`, etc.) — never let tests call real services.
- Block config file discovery in mocks: return `null` for any path containing `.dmtools/config` to prevent loading a parent repo's real config.
- Project-specific test suites (loading files from `.dmtools/`) must guard with a file-existence check so they skip gracefully in standalone context.

Example mock pattern:
```js
var fileReadMock = function(opts) {
    var p = opts && (opts.path || opts);
    if (fileMap[p] !== undefined) return fileMap[p];
    if (p && p.indexOf('.dmtools/config') !== -1) return null; // block real config
    try { return file_read(opts); } catch (e) { return null; }
};
```

### Live end-to-end testing without an AI CLI

Unit tests cover JS logic with mocks, but a Teammate agent's full wiring
(preJSAction → input context → preCliJSAction → CLI → postJSAction) can also
be exercised against **real Jira/Confluence/etc.** without invoking the real
AI CLI (`scripts/run-agent.sh`). Two dmtools features make this possible:

1. **CLI param overrides** — `dmtools run <config.json> --key value` patches
   the `params` block. Values that look like JSON arrays/objects are parsed as
   JSON, so even `cliCommands` and `customParams` can be overridden:

   ```bash
   dmtools run agents/story_solution.json \
     --inputJql "key = PROJ-123" \
     --cliCommands '["/path/to/fake_cli.sh"]' \
     --customParams '{"contentOutput":{"target":"confluence","space":"DOC","parentPageId":"123456"}}' \
     --alwaysPostComments false \
     --cleanupInputFolder false
   ```

2. **A fake CLI script** that mimics the agent contract: read `input/`, write
   `outputs/response.md` (and any other files the post-action expects, e.g.
   `outputs/confluence_replies.json`). Keep it outside the repo (it is
   project- and machine-specific):

   ```bash
   #!/bin/bash
   set -e
   mkdir -p outputs
   printf '# Fake output\n\nGenerated by the e2e fake CLI.\n' > outputs/response.md
   ```

Rules for live e2e runs:

- **Never commit live-e2e configs or scripts to this repo** — they contain
  real ticket keys, page IDs and space keys, which violates the
  project-agnostic rule. Keep them in a scratch directory or pass everything
  via CLI overrides.
- Run against **dedicated garbage objects** (a test ticket and a test
  Confluence page clearly marked "safe to delete"), never real work items.
- Pass `--cleanupInputFolder false` so you can inspect `input/<KEY>/`
  afterwards, and `--alwaysPostComments false` to keep the test ticket quiet.
- After the run, verify the side effects directly (e.g. `jira_get_ticket`,
  `confluence_content_by_id`, `confluence_get_page_inline_comments`) rather
  than trusting the job log.

## Conventions

### No project-specific content — STRICT RULE

**This is a public, product-agnostic repository. NEVER commit anything company- or customer-specific here.** Violations are a fireable offense and require history rewrite.

Forbidden anywhere in this repo (code, comments, prompts, instructions, tests, docs, commit messages):

- Company, customer, or product names
- Internal hostnames, URLs, IPs, Jira/Confluence links, real ticket keys
- Internal label/branch/repo naming conventions tied to one organization
- File paths pointing to internal repos, internal registry URLs
- Sample data copied from real internal systems

Everything here must be **generic and configurable**: names like `example.com`, `PROJ-123`, `acme`; behavior driven by `customParams` / `.dmtools/config.js` in the consuming repo. Project context goes in the target repo's `.dmtools/config.js` or the corporate orchestrator repo…

Otherwise `throughCanonicalRoot` walks ancestors of the key and checks if `realpathOrSelf(dir) === canonicalRoot` — i.e., if any ANCESTOR DIRECTORY of the key IS the project root (realpath'd).

In CI: projectRoot = `$RUNER_TEMP/inst` (realpath: /home/runner/work/_temp/inst), coverage keys = `$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/js/...` = `/home/runner/work/dmtools-agents/dmtools-agents/js/...`. # pr-1115: gh-1107 SM: check-run stamps fail with 'Bad substitution' — job names interpolated into shell string ## Description Closes #1107 ### What changed Check-run stamps no longer interpolate run-derived text into a shell string. `stampValidationChecksForModule` now builds the Checks-API request body as JSON (`{name, head_sha, status, conclusion?, details_url?, output:{title, summary}}`), writes it to a temp file, posts it with `gh api -X POST repos/{o}/{r}/check-runs --input `, and deletes the file in `finally`. A job named `Lockfile smoke (${{ matrix.os }} release)` therefore reaches dash only as JSON payload bytes — the command string carries zero untrusted bytes, so `Bad substitution` (exit 2, missing stamps, blocked PRs) cannot recur. Transport + helpers live in a new `js/common/checkRunStamp.js`. ### Key decisions - Temp-file JSON body (`--input`) instead of escaping: JSON preserves `${{ }}`, `$(id)`, backticks, `"`, `\`, newlines byte-for-byte (AC1); the same gh-960 PR-body precedent `scm.js` already uses. Only the fixed repo path and a digits-only `/tmp/sm-check-run--.json` path ever touch the shell (AC2). - Temp file deleted in `finally` — on success AND failure (AC3); an unwritable temp dir warns and skips exactly like the old failure mode (E2); summary > 65,535 chars truncates with a marker, never rejected (E1). - `stampLinkBlock` dropped its legacy `"` → `'` mangling — the body must be byte-for-byte, and quotes are safe inside JSON. - AC5 audit of `cli_execute_command` sites interpolating PR/run-derived text — all converted through ONE `shellQuote` (re-exported from `factory/token_usage.js` via `checkRunStamp.js`): - `dispatchCiWorkflow` `--ref ` (validate-arm CI dispatch) — was bare unquoted; - silent-update chain (classic): `--branch ` + push refspec — was bare; - silent-update chain (fork, gh-1070): `git checkout -B ` + `HEAD:` refspec — was bare; - gh-757 ghost dispatch — inline `'`-escaping normalized to the shared helper (byte-identical output); - gh-857 placeholder conclusion PATCH — `details_url` (run-derived URL) + `output[summary]` values now shellQuote'd; - gh-998 zombie-sweep PATCH — fixed-literal summary moved to the same helper so the shape cannot regress. - Audited and left as-is (no untrusted bytes): probe calls keyed on config `ciWorkflow`, hex head SHAs, numeric run/check-run ids; local-teammate runner (Jira key + config values); factory-state transport (already shellQuote'd); zombie/gh-848 PATCH summaries (fixed literals); stderr-file paths (sanitized at creation). - DRY path unchanged (AC4): same `[dry] stamp …` log, no file, no command. ### How to verify ```bash dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json # stamp + hostile-string pins dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_checkRunStamp.json # transport unit tests (UT-1..3, E1, E2) dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json # full suite: 4760 passed, 0 failed ``` Real-shell spot check (reproduces the live bug and proves the fix): the old `-f summary="…(${{ matrix.os }})…"` form exits 2 with `Bad substitution` under dash; the new `--input` form posts the body byte-for-byte, and a shellQuote'd `--ref 'ai/g'\''h-50;$(touch /tmp/pwn)'` dispatch expands nothing.
Transport diagram ```mermaid flowchart TD SYNC[syncValidationChecks / validate_pr] --> STAMP[stampValidationChecksForModule] STAMP --> LB[stampLinkBlock jobs probe] LB --> BODY[checkRunStamp.buildCheckRunBody
E1: truncate summary at 65,535] BODY --> FW[file_write /tmp/sm-check-run-N.json] FW --> CLI[gh api -X POST repos/o/r/check-runs --input tmpfile
zero untrusted bytes] CLI --> DEL[file_delete in finally — success AND failure] CLI -->|throws| WARN[warn and skip — next check name] ```

# pr-1115: gh-1107 SM: check-run stamps fail with 'Bad substitution' — job names interpolated into shell string ## Description Closes #1107 ### What changed Check-run stamps no longer interpolate run-derived text into a shell string. `stampValidationChecksForModule` now builds the Checks-API request body as JSON (`{name, head_sha, status, conclusion?, details_url?, output:{title, summary}}`), writes it to a temp file, posts it with `gh api -X POST repos/{o}/{r}/check-runs --input `, and deletes the file in `finally`. A job named `Lockfile smoke (${{ matrix.os }} release)` therefore reaches dash only as JSON payload bytes — the command string carries zero untrusted bytes, so `Bad substitution` (exit 2, missing stamps, blocked PRs) cannot recur. Transport + helpers live in a new `js/common/checkRunStamp.js`. ### Key decisions - Temp-file JSON body (`--input`) instead of escaping: JSON preserves `${{ }}`, `$(id)`, backticks, `"`, `\`, newlines byte-for-byte (AC1); the same gh-960 PR-body precedent `scm.js` already uses. Only the fixed repo path and a digits-only `/tmp/sm-check-run--.json` path ever touch the shell (AC2). - Temp file deleted in `finally` — on success AND failure (AC3); an unwritable temp dir warns and skips exactly like the old failure mode (E2); summary > 65,535 chars truncates with a marker, never rejected (E1). - `stampLinkBlock` dropped its legacy `"` → `'` mangling — the body must be byte-for-byte, and quotes are safe inside JSON. - AC5 audit of `cli_execute_command` sites interpolating PR/run-derived text — all converted through ONE `shellQuote` (re-exported from `factory/token_usage.js` via `checkRunStamp.js`): - `dispatchCiWorkflow` `--ref ` (validate-arm CI dispatch) — was bare unquoted; - silent-update chain (classic): `--branch ` + push refspec — was bare; - silent-update chain (fork, gh-1070): `git checkout -B ` + `HEAD:` refspec — was bare; - gh-757 ghost dispatch — inline `'`-escaping normalized to the shared helper (byte-identical output); - gh-857 placeholder conclusion PATCH — `details_url` (run-derived URL) + `output[summary]` values now shellQuote'd; - gh-998 zombie-sweep PATCH — fixed-literal summary moved to the same helper so the shape cannot regress. - Audited and left as-is (no untrusted bytes): probe calls keyed on config `ciWorkflow`, hex head SHAs, numeric run/check-run ids; local-teammate runner (Jira key + config values); factory-state transport (already shellQuote'd); zombie/gh-848 PATCH summaries (fixed literals); stderr-file paths (sanitized at creation). - DRY path unchanged (AC4): same `[dry] stamp …` log, no file, no command. ### How to verify ```bash dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json # stamp + hostile-string pins dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_checkRunStamp.json # transport unit tests (UT-1..3, E1, E2) dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json # full suite: 4760 passed, 0 failed ``` Real-shell spot check (reproduces the live bug and proves the fix): the old `-f summary="…(${{ matrix.os }})…"` form exits 2 with `Bad substitution` under dash; the new `--input` form posts the body byte-for-byte, and a shellQuote'd `--ref 'ai/g'\''h-50;$(touch /tmp/pwn)'` dispatch expands nothing.

E1: truncate summary at 65,535] BODY --> FW[file_write /tmp/sm-check-run-N.json] FW --> CLI[gh api -X POST repos/o/r/check-runs --input tmpfile
zero untrusted bytes] CLI --> DEL[file_delete in finally — success AND failure] CLI -->|throws| WARN[warn and skip — next check name] ```

# pr-1115: gh-1107 SM: check-run stamps fail with 'Bad substitution' — job names interpolated into shell string ## Description Closes #1107 ### What changed Check-run stamps no longer interpolate run-derived text into a shell string. `stampValidationChecksForModule` now builds the Checks-API request body as JSON (`{name, head_sha, status, conclusion?, details_url?, output:{title, summary}}`), writes it to a temp file, posts it with `gh api -X POST repos/{o}/{r}/check-runs --input `, and deletes the file in `finally`. A job named `Lockfile smoke (${{ matrix.os }} release)` therefore reaches dash only as JSON payload bytes — the command string carries zero untrusted bytes, so `Bad substitution` (exit 2, missing stamps, blocked PRs) cannot recur. Transport + helpers live in a new `js/common/checkRunStamp.js`. ### Key decisions - Temp-file JSON body (`--input`) instead of escaping: JSON preserves `${{ }}`, `$(id)`, backticks, `"`, `\`, newlines byte-for-byte (AC1); the same gh-960 PR-body precedent `scm.js` already uses. Only the fixed repo path and a digits-only `/tmp/sm-check-run--.json` path ever touch the shell (AC2). - Temp file deleted in `finally` — on success AND failure (AC3); an unwritable temp dir warns and skips exactly like the old failure mode (E2); summary > 65,535 chars truncates with a marker, never rejected (E1). - `stampLinkBlock` dropped its legacy `"` → `'` mangling — the body must be byte-for-byte, and quotes are safe inside JSON. - AC5 audit of `cli_execute_command` sites interpolating PR/run-derived text — all converted through ONE `shellQuote` (re-exported from `factory/token_usage.js` via `checkRunStamp.js`): - `dispatchCiWorkflow` `--ref ` (validate-arm CI dispatch) — was bare unquoted; - silent-update chain (classic): `--branch ` + push refspec — was bare; - silent-update chain (fork, gh-1070): `git checkout -B ` + `HEAD:` refspec — was bare; - gh-757 ghost dispatch — inline `'`-escaping normalized to the shared helper (byte-identical output); - gh-857 placeholder conclusion PATCH — `details_url` (run-derived URL) + `output[summary]` values now shellQuote'd; - gh-998 zombie-sweep PATCH — fixed-literal summary moved to the same helper so the shape cannot regress. - Audited and left as-is (no untrusted bytes): probe calls keyed on config `ciWorkflow`, hex head SHAs, numeric run/check-run ids; local-teammate runner (Jira key + config values); factory-state transport (already shellQuote'd); zombie/gh-848 PATCH summaries (fixed literals); stderr-file paths (sanitized at creation). - DRY path unchanged (AC4): same `[dry] stamp …` log, no file, no command. ### How to verify ```bash dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json # stamp + hostile-string pins dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_checkRunStamp.json # transport unit tests (UT-1..3, E1, E2) dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json # full suite: 4760 passed, 0 failed ``` Real-shell spot check (reproduces the live bug and proves the fix): the old `-f summary="…(${{ matrix.os }})…"` form exits 2 with `Bad substitution` under dash; the new `--input` form posts the body byte-for-byte, and a shellQuote'd `--ref 'ai/g'\''h-50;$(touch /tmp/pwn)'` dispatch expands nothing.

# pr-1115: gh-1107 SM: check-run stamps fail with 'Bad substitution' — job names interpolated into shell string ## Description Closes #1107 ### What changed Check-run stamps no longer interpolate run-derived text into a shell string. `stampValidationChecksForModule` now builds the Checks-API request body as JSON (`{name, head_sha, status, conclusion?, details_url?, output:{title, summary}}`), writes it to a temp file, posts it with `gh api -X POST repos/{o}/{r}/check-runs --input `, and deletes the file in `finally`. A job named `Lockfile smoke (${{ matrix.os }} release)` therefore reaches dash only as JSON payload bytes — the command string carries zero untrusted bytes, so `Bad substitution` (exit 2, missing stamps, blocked PRs) cannot recur. Transport + helpers live in a new `js/common/checkRunStamp.js`. ### Key decisions - Temp-file JSON body (`--input`) instead of escaping: JSON preserves `${{ }}`, `$(id)`, backticks, `"`, `\`, newlines byte-for-byte (AC1); the same gh-960 PR-body precedent `scm.js` already uses. Only the fixed repo path and a digits-only `/tmp/sm-check-run--.json` path ever touch the shell (AC2). - Temp file deleted in `finally` — on success AND failure (AC3); an unwritable temp dir warns and skips exactly like the old failure mode (E2); summary > 65,535 chars truncates with a marker, never rejected (E1). - `stampLinkBlock` dropped its legacy `"` → `'` mangling — the body must be byte-for-byte, and quotes are safe inside JSON. - AC5 audit of `cli_execute_command` sites interpolating PR/run-derived text — all converted through ONE `shellQuote` (re-exported from `factory/token_usage.js` via `checkRunStamp.js`): - `dispatchCiWorkflow` `--ref ` (validate-arm CI dispatch) — was bare unquoted; - silent-update chain (classic): `--branch ` + push refspec — was bare; - silent-update chain (fork, gh-1070): `git checkout -B ` + `HEAD:` refspec — was bare; - gh-757 ghost dispatch — inline `'`-escaping normalized to the shared helper (byte-identical output); - gh-857 placeholder conclusion PATCH — `details_url` (run-derived URL) + `output[summary]` values now shellQuote'd; - gh-998 zombie-sweep PATCH — fixed-literal summary moved to the same helper so the shape cannot regress. - Audited and left as-is (no untrusted bytes): probe calls keyed on config `ciWorkflow`, hex head SHAs, numeric run/check-run ids; local-teammate runner (Jira key + config values); factory-state transport (already shellQuote'd); zombie/gh-848 PATCH summaries (fixed literals); stderr-file paths (sanitized at creation). - DRY path unchanged (AC4): same `[dry] stamp …` log, no file, no command. ### How to verify ```bash dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json # stamp + hostile-string pins dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_checkRunStamp.json # transport unit tests (UT-1..3, E1, E2) dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json # full suite: 4760 passed, 0 failed ``` Real-shell spot check (reproduces the live bug and proves the fix): the old `-f summary="…(${{ matrix.os }})…"` form exits 2 with `Bad substitution` under dash; the new `--input` form posts the body byte-for-byte, and a shellQuote'd `--ref 'ai/g'\''h-50;$(touch /tmp/pwn)'` dispatch expands nothing.

E1: truncate summary at 65,535] BODY --> FW[file_write /tmp/sm-check-run-N.json] FW --> CLI[gh api -X POST repos/o/r/check-runs --input tmpfile
zero untrusted bytes] CLI --> DEL[file_delete in finally — success AND failure] CLI -->|throws| WARN[warn and skip — next check name] ```

# pr-1115: gh-1107 SM: check-run stamps fail with 'Bad substitution' — job names interpolated into shell string ## Description Closes #1107 ### What changed Check-run stamps no longer interpolate run-derived text into a shell string. `stampValidationChecksForModule` now builds the Checks-API request body as JSON (`{name, head_sha, status, conclusion?, details_url?, output:{title, summary}}`), writes it to a temp file, posts it with `gh api -X POST repos/{o}/{r}/check-runs --input `, and deletes the file in `finally`. A job named `Lockfile smoke (${{ matrix.os }} release)` therefore reaches dash only as JSON payload bytes — the command string carries zero untrusted bytes, so `Bad substitution` (exit 2, missing stamps, blocked PRs) cannot recur. Transport + helpers live in a new `js/common/checkRunStamp.js`. ### Key decisions - Temp-file JSON body (`--input`) instead of escaping: JSON preserves `${{ }}`, `$(id)`, backticks, `"`, `\`, newlines byte-for-byte (AC1); the same gh-960 PR-body precedent `scm.js` already uses. Only the fixed repo path and a digits-only `/tmp/sm-check-run--.json` path ever touch the shell (AC2). - Temp file deleted in `finally` — on success AND failure (AC3); an unwritable temp dir warns and skips exactly like the old failure mode (E2); summary > 65,535 chars truncates with a marker, never rejected (E1). - `stampLinkBlock` dropped its legacy `"` → `'` mangling — the body must be byte-for-byte, and quotes are safe inside JSON. - AC5 audit of `cli_execute_command` sites interpolating PR/run-derived text — all converted through ONE `shellQuote` (re-exported from `factory/token_usage.js` via `checkRunStamp.js`): - `dispatchCiWorkflow` `--ref ` (validate-arm CI dispatch) — was bare unquoted; - silent-update chain (classic): `--branch ` + push refspec — was bare; - silent-update chain (fork, gh-1070): `git checkout -B ` + `HEAD:` refspec — was bare; - gh-757 ghost dispatch — inline `'`-escaping normalized to the shared helper (byte-identical output); - gh-857 placeholder conclusion PATCH — `details_url` (run-derived URL) + `output[summary]` values now shellQuote'd; - gh-998 zombie-sweep PATCH — fixed-literal summary moved to the same helper so the shape cannot regress. - Audited and left as-is (no untrusted bytes): probe calls keyed on config `ciWorkflow`, hex head SHAs, numeric run/check-run ids; local-teammate runner (Jira key + config values); factory-state transport (already shellQuote'd); zombie/gh-848 PATCH summaries (fixed literals); stderr-file paths (sanitized at creation). - DRY path unchanged (AC4): same `[dry] stamp …` log, no file, no command. ### How to verify ```bash dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json # stamp + hostile-string pins dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_checkRunStamp.json # transport unit tests (UT-1..3, E1, E2) dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json # full suite: 4760 passed, 0 failed ``` Real-shell spot check (reproduces the live bug and proves the fix): the old `-f summary="…(${{ matrix.os }})…"` form exits 2 with `Bad substitution` under dash; the new `--input` form posts the body byte-for-byte, and a shellQuote'd `--ref 'ai/g'\''h-50;$(touch /tmp/pwn)'` dispatch expands nothing.

# pr-1115: gh-1107 SM: check-run stamps fail with 'Bad substitution' — job names interpolated into shell string ## Description Closes #1107 ### What changed Check-run stamps no longer interpolate run-derived text into a shell string. `stampValidationChecksForModule` now builds the Checks-API request body as JSON (`{name, head_sha, status, conclusion?, details_url?, output:{title, summary}}`), writes it to a temp file, posts it with `gh api -X POST repos/{o}/{r}/check-runs --input `, and deletes the file in `finally`. A job named `Lockfile smoke (${{ matrix.os }} release)` therefore reaches dash only as JSON payload bytes — the command string carries zero untrusted bytes, so `Bad substitution` (exit 2, missing stamps, blocked PRs) cannot recur. Transport + helpers live in a new `js/common/checkRunStamp.js`. ### Key decisions - Temp-file JSON body (`--input`) instead of escaping: JSON preserves `${{ }}`, `$(id)`, backticks, `"`, `\`, newlines byte-for-byte (AC1); the same gh-960 PR-body precedent `scm.js` already uses. Only the fixed repo path and a digits-only `/tmp/sm-check-run--.json` path ever touch the shell (AC2). - Temp file deleted in `finally` — on success AND failure (AC3); an unwritable temp dir warns and skips exactly like the old failure mode (E2); summary > 65,535 chars truncates with a marker, never rejected (E1). - `stampLinkBlock` dropped its legacy `"` → `'` mangling — the body must be byte-for-byte, and quotes are safe inside JSON. - AC5 audit of `cli_execute_command` sites interpolating PR/run-derived text — all converted through ONE `shellQuote` (re-exported from `factory/token_usage.js` via `checkRunStamp.js`): - `dispatchCiWorkflow` `--ref ` (validate-arm CI dispatch) — was bare unquoted; - silent-update chain (classic): `--branch ` + push refspec — was bare; - silent-update chain (fork, gh-1070): `git checkout -B ` + `HEAD:` refspec — was bare; - gh-757 ghost dispatch — inline `'`-escaping normalized to the shared helper (byte-identical output); - gh-857 placeholder conclusion PATCH — `details_url` (run-derived URL) + `output[summary]` values now shellQuote'd; - gh-998 zombie-sweep PATCH — fixed-literal summary moved to the same helper so the shape cannot regress. - Audited and left as-is (no untrusted bytes): probe calls keyed on config `ciWorkflow`, hex head SHAs, numeric run/check-run ids; local-teammate runner (Jira key + config values); factory-state transport (already shellQuote'd); zombie/gh-848 PATCH summaries (fixed literals); stderr-file paths (sanitized at creation). - DRY path unchanged (AC4): same `[dry] stamp …` log, no file, no command. ### How to verify ```bash dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json # stamp + hostile-string pins dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_checkRunStamp.json # transport unit tests (UT-1..3, E1, E2) dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json # full suite: 4760 passed, 0 failed ``` Real-shell spot check (reproduces the live bug and proves the fix): the old `-f summary="…(${{ matrix.os }})…"` form exits 2 with `Bad substitution` under dash; the new `--input` form posts the body byte-for-byte, and a shellQuote'd `--ref 'ai/g'\''h-50;$(touch /tmp/pwn)'` dispatch expands nothing.

E1: truncate summary at 65,535] BODY --> FW[file_write /tmp/sm-check-run-N.json] FW --> CLI[gh api -X POST repos/o/r/check-runs --input tmpfile
zero untrusted bytes] CLI --> DEL[file_delete in finally — success AND failure] CLI -->|throws| WARN[warn and skip — next check name] ```

# pr-1115: gh-1107 SM: check-run stamps fail with 'Bad substitution' — job names interpolated into shell string ## Description Closes #1107 ### What changed Check-run stamps no longer interpolate run-derived text into a shell string. `stampValidationChecksForModule` now builds the Checks-API request body as JSON (`{name, head_sha, status, conclusion?, details_url?, output:{title, summary}}`), writes it to a temp file, posts it with `gh api -X POST repos/{o}/{r}/check-runs --input `, and deletes the file in `finally`. A job named `Lockfile smoke (${{ matrix.os }} release)` therefore reaches dash only as JSON payload bytes — the command string carries zero untrusted bytes, so `Bad substitution` (exit 2, missing stamps, blocked PRs) cannot recur. Transport + helpers live in a new `js/common/checkRunStamp.js`. ### Key decisions - Temp-file JSON body (`--input`) instead of escaping: JSON preserves `${{ }}`, `$(id)`, backticks, `"`, `\`, newlines byte-for-byte (AC1); the same gh-960 PR-body precedent `scm.js` already uses. Only the fixed repo path and a digits-only `/tmp/sm-check-run--.json` path ever touch the shell (AC2). - Temp file deleted in `finally` — on success AND failure (AC3); an unwritable temp dir warns and skips exactly like the old failure mode (E2); - silent-update chain (classic): `--branch ` + push refspec — was bare; - silent-update chain (fork, gh-1070): `git checkout -B ` + `HEAD:` refspec — was bare; - gh-757 ghost dispatch — inline `'`-escaping normalized to the shared helper (byte-identical output); # pr-1115: gh-1107 SM: check-run stamps fail with 'Bad substitution' — job names interpolated into shell string ## Description Closes #1107 ### What changed Check-run stamps no longer interpolate run-derived text into a shell string. `stampValidationChecksForModule` now builds the Checks-API request body as JSON (`{name, head_sha, status, conclusion?, details_url?, output:{title, summary}}`), writes it to a temp file, posts it with `gh api -X POST repos/{o}/{r}/check-runs --input `, and deletes the file in `finally`. A job named `Lockfile smoke (${{ matrix.os }} release)` therefore reaches dash only as JSON payload bytes — the command string carries zero untrusted bytes, so `Bad substitution` (exit 2, missing stamps, blocked PRs) cannot recur. Transport + helpers live in a new `js/common/checkRunStamp.js`. ### Key decisions - Temp-file JSON body (`--input`) instead of escaping: JSON preserves `${{ }}`, `$(id)`, backticks, `"`, `\`, newlines byte-for-byte (AC1); the same gh-960 PR-body precedent `scm.js` already uses. Only the fixed repo path and a digits-only `/tmp/sm-check-run--.json` path ever touch the shell (AC2). - Temp file deleted in `finally` — on success AND failure (AC3); an unwritable temp dir warns and skips exactly like the old failure mode (E2); summary > 65,535 chars truncates with a marker, never rejected (E1). - `stampLinkBlock` dropped its legacy `"` → `'` mangling — the body must be byte-for-byte, and quotes are safe inside JSON. - AC5 audit of `cli_execute_command` sites interpolating PR/run-derived text — all converted through ONE `shellQuote` (re-exported from `factory/token_usage.js` via `checkRunStamp.js`): - `dispatchCiWorkflow` `--ref ` (validate-arm CI dispatch) — was bare unquoted; - silent-update chain (classic): `--branch ` + push refspec — was bare; - silent-update chain (fork, gh-1070): `git checkout -B ` + `HEAD:` refspec — was bare; - gh-757 ghost dispatch — inline `'`-escaping normalized to the shared helper (byte-identical output); - gh-857 placeholder conclusion PATCH — `details_url` (run-derived URL) + `output[summary]` values now shellQuote'd; - gh-998 zombie-sweep PATCH — fixed-literal summary moved to the same helper so the shape cannot regress. - Audited and left as-is (no untrusted bytes): probe calls keyed on config `ciWorkflow`, hex head SHAs, numeric run/check-run ids; local-teammate runner (Jira key + config values); factory-state transport (already shellQuote'd); zombie/gh-848 PATCH summaries (fixed literals); stderr-file paths (sanitized at creation). - DRY path unchanged (AC4): same `[dry] stamp …` log, no file, no command. ### How to verify ```bash dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json # stamp + hostile-string pins dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_checkRunStamp.json # transport unit tests (UT-1..3, E1, E2) dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json # full suite: 4760 passed, 0 failed ``` Real-shell spot check (reproduces the live bug and proves the fix): the old `-f summary="…(${{ matrix.os }})…"` form exits 2 with `Bad substitution` under dash; the new `--input` form posts the body byte-for-byte, and a shellQuote'd `--ref 'ai/g'\''h-50;$(touch /tmp/pwn)'` dispatch expands nothing.

E1: truncate summary at 65,535] BODY --> FW[file_write /tmp/sm-check-run-N.json] FW --> CLI[gh api -X POST repos/o/r/check-runs --input tmpfile
zero untrusted bytes] CLI --> DEL[file_delete in finally — success AND failure] CLI -->|throws| WARN[warn and skip — next check name] ```

# pr-1115: gh-1107 SM: check-run stamps fail with 'Bad substitution' — job names interpolated into shell string ## Description Closes #1107 ### What changed Check-run stamps no longer interpolate run-derived text into a shell string. `stampValidationChecksForModule` now builds the Checks-API request body as JSON (`{name, head_sha, status, conclusion?, details_url?, output:{title, summary}}`), writes it to a temp file, posts it with `gh api -X POST repos/{o}/{r}/check-runs --input `, and deletes the file in `finally`. A job named `Lockfile smoke (${{ matrix.os }} release)` therefore reaches dash only as JSON payload bytes — the command string carries zero untrusted bytes, so `Bad substitution` (exit 2, missing stamps, blocked PRs) cannot recur. Transport + helpers live in a new `js/common/checkRunStamp.js`. ### Key decisions - Temp-file JSON body (`--input`) instead of escaping: JSON preserves `${{ }}`, `$(id)`, backticks, `"`, `\`, newlines byte-for-byte (AC1); the same gh-960 PR-body precedent `scm.js` already uses. Only the fixed repo path and a digits-only `/tmp/sm-check-run--.json` path ever touch the shell (AC2). - Temp file deleted in `finally` — on success AND failure (AC3); an unwritable temp dir warns and skips exactly like the old failure mode (E2); summary > 65,535 chars truncates with a marker, never rejected (E1). - `stampLinkBlock` dropped its legacy `"` → `'` mangling — the body must be byte-for-byte, and quotes are safe inside JSON. - AC5 audit of `cli_execute_command` sites interpolating PR/run-derived text — all converted through ONE `shellQuote` (re-exported from `factory/token_usage.js` via `checkRunStamp.js`): - `dispatchCiWorkflow` `--ref ` (validate-arm CI dispatch) — was bare unquoted; - silent-update chain (classic): `--branch ` + push refspec — was bare; - silent-update chain (fork, gh-1070): `git checkout -B ` + `HEAD:` refspec — was bare; - gh-757 ghost dispatch — inline `'`-escaping normalized to the shared helper (byte-identical output); - gh-857 placeholder conclusion PATCH — `details_url` (run-derived URL) + `output[summary]` values now shellQuote'd; - gh-998 zombie-sweep PATCH — fixed-literal summary moved to the same helper so the shape cannot regress. - Audited and left as-is (no untrusted bytes): probe calls keyed on config `ciWorkflow`, hex head SHAs, numeric run/check-run ids; local-teammate runner (Jira key + config values); factory-state transport (already shellQuote'd); zombie/gh-848 PATCH summaries (fixed literals); stderr-file paths (sanitized at creation). - DRY path unchanged (AC4): same `[dry] stamp …` log, no file, no command. ### How to verify ```bash dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json # stamp + hostile-string pins dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_checkRunStamp.json # transport unit tests (UT-1..3, E1, E2) dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json # full suite: 4760 passed, 0 failed ``` Real-shell spot check (reproduces the live bug and proves the fix): the old `-f summary="…(${{ matrix.os }})…"` form exits 2 with `Bad substitution` under dash; the new `--input` form posts the body byte-for-byte, and a shellQuote'd `--ref 'ai/g'\''h-50;$(touch /tmp/pwn)'` dispatch expands nothing.
Transport diagram ```mermaid flowchart TD SYNC[syncValidationChecks / validate_pr] --> STAMP[stampValidationChecksForModule] STAMP --> LB[stampLinkBlock jobs probe] LB --> BODY[checkRunStamp.buildCheckRunBody
E1: truncate summary at 65,535] BODY --> FW[file_write /tmp/sm-check-run-N.json] FW --> CLI[gh api -X POST repos/o/r/check-runs --input tmpfile
zero untrusted bytes] CLI --> DEL[file_delete in finally — success AND failure] CLI -->|throws| WARN[warn and skip — next check name] ```

# pr-1115: gh-1107 SM: check-run stamps fail with 'Bad substitution' — job names interpolated into shell string ## Description Closes #1107 ### What changed Check-run stamps no longer interpolate run-derived text into a shell string. `stampValidationChecksForModule` now builds the Checks-API request body as JSON (`{name, head_sha, status, conclusion?, details_url?, output:{title, summary}}`), writes it to a temp file, posts it with `gh api -X POST repos/{o}/{r}/check-runs --input `, and deletes the file in `finally`. A job named `Lockfile smoke (${{ matrix.os }} release)` therefore reaches dash only as JSON payload bytes — the command string carries zero untrusted bytes, so `Bad substitution` (exit 2, missing stamps, blocked PRs) cannot recur. Transport + helpers live in a new `js/common/checkRunStamp.js`. ### Key decisions - Temp-file JSON body (`--input`) instead of escaping: JSON preserves `${{ }}`, `$(id)`, backticks, `"`, `\`, newlines byte-for-byte (AC1); the same gh-960 PR-body precedent `scm.js` already uses. Only the fixed repo path and a digits-only `/tmp/sm-check-run--.json` path ever touch the shell (AC2). - Temp file deleted in `finally` — on success AND failure (AC3); an unwritable temp dir warns and skips exactly like the old failure mode (E2); summary > 65,535 chars truncates with a marker, never rejected (E1). - `stampLinkBlock` dropped its legacy `"` → `'` mangling — the body must be byte-for-byte, and quotes are safe inside JSON. - AC5 audit of `cli_execute_command` sites interpolating PR/run-derived text — all converted through ONE `shellQuote` (re-exported from `factory/token_usage.js` via `checkRunStamp.js`): - `dispatchCiWorkflow` `--ref ` (validate-arm CI dispatch) — was bare unquoted; - silent-update chain (classic): `--branch ` + push refspec — was bare; - silent-update chain (fork, gh-1070): `git checkout -B ` + `HEAD:` refspec — was bare; - gh-757 ghost dispatch — inline `'`-escaping normalized to the shared helper (byte-identical output); - gh-857 placeholder conclusion PATCH — `details_url` (run-derived URL) + `output[summary]` values now shellQuote'd; - gh-998 zombie-sweep PATCH — fixed-literal summary moved to the same helper so the shape cannot regress. - Audited and left as-is (no untrusted bytes): probe calls keyed on config `ciWorkflow`, hex head SHAs, numeric run/check-run ids; local-teammate runner (Jira key + config values); factory-state transport (already shellQuote'd); zombie/gh-848 PATCH summaries (fixed literals); stderr-file paths (sanitized at creation). - DRY path unchanged (AC4): same `[dry] stamp …` log, no file, no command. ### How to verify ```bash dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json # stamp + hostile-string pins dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_checkRunStamp.json # transport unit tests (UT-1..3, E1, E2) dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json # full suite: 4760 passed, 0 failed ``` Real-shell spot check (reproduces the live bug and proves the fix): the old `-f summary="…(${{ matrix.os }})…"` form exits 2 with `Bad substitution` under dash; the new `--input` form posts the body byte-for-byte, and a shellQuote'd `--ref 'ai/g'\''h-50;$(touch /tmp/pwn)'` dispatch expands nothing.

E1: truncate summary at 65,535] BODY --> FW[file_write /tmp/sm-check-run-N.json] FW --> CLI[gh api -X POST repos/o/r/check-runs --input tmpfile
zero untrusted bytes] CLI --> DEL[file_delete in finally — success AND failure] CLI -->|throws| WARN[warn and skip — next check name] ```

# pr-1115: gh-1107 SM: check-run stamps fail with 'Bad substitution' — job names interpolated into shell string ## Description Closes #1107 ### What changed Check-run stamps no longer interpolate run-derived text into a shell string. `stampValidationChecksForModule` now builds the Checks-API request body as JSON (`{name, head_sha, status, conclusion?, details_url?, output:{title, summary}}`), writes it to a temp file, posts it with `gh api -X POST repos/{o}/{r}/check-runs --input `, and deletes the file in `finally`. A job named `Lockfile smoke (${{ matrix.os }} release)` therefore reaches dash only as JSON payload bytes — the command string carries zero untrusted bytes, so `Bad substitution` (exit 2, missing stamps, blocked PRs) cannot recur. Transport + helpers live in a new `js/common/checkRunStamp.js`. ### Key decisions - Temp-file JSON body (`--input`) instead of escaping: JSON preserves `${{ }}`, `$(id)`, backticks, `"`, `\`, newlines byte-for-byte (AC1); the same gh-960 PR-body precedent `scm.js` already uses. Only the fixed repo path and a digits-only `/tmp/sm-check-run--.json` path ever touch the shell (AC2). - Temp file deleted in `finally` — on success AND failure (AC3); an unwritable temp dir warns and skips exactly like the old failure mode (E2); summary > 65,535 chars truncates with a marker, never rejected (E1). - `stampLinkBlock` dropped its legacy `"` → `'` mangling — the body must be byte-for-byte, and quotes are safe inside JSON. - AC5 audit of `cli_execute_command` sites interpolating PR/run-derived text — all converted through ONE `shellQuote` (re-exported from `factory/token_usage.js` via `checkRunStamp.js`): - `dispatchCiWorkflow` `--ref ` (validate-arm CI dispatch) — was bare unquoted; - silent-update chain (classic): `--branch ` + push refspec — was bare; - silent-update chain (fork, gh-1070): `git checkout -B ` + `HEAD:` refspec — was bare; - gh-757 ghost dispatch — inline `'`-escaping normalized to the shared helper (byte-identical output); - gh-857 placeholder conclusion PATCH — `details_url` (run-derived URL) + `output[summary]` values now shellQuote'd; - gh-998 zombie-sweep PATCH — fixed-literal summary moved to the same helper so the shape cannot regress. - Audited and left as-is (no untrusted bytes): probe calls keyed on config `ciWorkflow`, hex head SHAs, numeric run/check-run ids; local-teammate runner (Jira key + config values); factory-state transport (already shellQuote'd); zombie/gh-848 PATCH summaries (fixed literals); stderr-file paths (sanitized at creation). - DRY path unchanged (AC4): same `[dry] stamp …` log, no file, no command. ### How to verify ```bash dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json # stamp + hostile-string pins dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_checkRunStamp.json # transport unit tests (UT-1..3, E1, E2) dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json # full suite: 4760 passed, 0 failed ``` Real-shell spot check (reproduces the live bug and proves the fix): the old `-f summary="…(${{ matrix.os }})…"` form exits 2 with `Bad substitution` under dash; the new `--input` form posts the body byte-for-byte, and a shellQuote'd `--ref 'ai/g'\''h-50;$(touch /tmp/pwn)'` dispatch expands nothing.
Transport diagram ```mermaid flowchart TD SYNC[syncValidationChecks / validate_pr] --> STAMP[stampValidationChecksForModule] STAMP --> LB[stampLinkBlock jobs probe] LB --> BODY[checkRunStamp.buildCheckRunBody
E1: truncate summary at 65,535] BODY --> FW[file_write /tmp/sm-check-run-N.json] FW --> CLI[gh api -X POST repos/o/r/check-runs --input tmpfile
zero untrusted bytes] CLI --> DEL[file_delete in finally — success AND failure] CLI -->|throws| WARN[warn and skip — next check name] ```

# pr-1115: gh-1107 SM: check-run stamps fail with 'Bad substitution' — job names interpolated into shell string ## Description Closes #1107 ### What changed Check-run stamps no longer interpolate run-derived text into a shell string. `stampValidationChecksForModule` now builds the Checks-API request body as JSON (`{name, head_sha, status, conclusion?, details_url?, output:{title, summary}}`), writes it to a temp file, posts it with `gh api -X POST repos/{o}/{r}/check-runs --input `, and deletes the file in `finally`. A job named `Lockfile smoke (${{ matrix.os }} release)` therefore reaches dash only as JSON payload bytes — the command string carries zero untrusted bytes, so `Bad substitution` (exit 2, missing stamps, blocked PRs) cannot recur. Transport + helpers live in a new `js/common/checkRunStamp.js`. ### Key decisions - Temp-file JSON body (`--input`) instead of escaping: JSON preserves `${{ }}`, `$(id)`, backticks, `"`, `\`, newlines byte-for-byte (AC1); the same gh-960 PR-body precedent `scm.js` already uses. Only the fixed repo path and a digits-only `/tmp/sm-check-run--.json` path ever touch the shell (AC2). - Temp file deleted in `finally` — on success AND failure (AC3); an unwritable temp dir warns and skips exactly like the old failure mode (E2); summary > 65,535 chars truncates with a marker, never rejected (E1). - `stampLinkBlock` dropped its legacy `"` → `'` mangling — the body must be byte-for-byte, and quotes are safe inside JSON. - AC5 audit of `cli_execute_command` sites interpolating PR/run-derived text — all converted through ONE `shellQuote` (re-exported from `factory/token_usage.js` via `checkRunStamp.js`): - `dispatchCiWorkflow` `--ref ` (validate-arm CI dispatch) — was bare unquoted; - silent-update chain (classic): `--branch ` + push refspec — was bare; - silent-update chain (fork, gh-1070): `git checkout -B ` + `HEAD:` refspec — was bare; - gh-757 ghost dispatch — inline `'`-escaping normalized to the shared helper (byte-identical output); - gh-857 placeholder conclusion PATCH — `details_url` (run-derived URL) + `output[summary]` values now shellQuote'd; - gh-998 zombie-sweep PATCH — fixed-literal summary moved to the same helper so the shape cannot regress. - Audited and left as-is (no untrusted bytes): probe calls keyed on config `ciWorkflow`, hex head SHAs, numeric run/check-run ids; local-teammate runner (Jira key + config values); factory-state transport (already shellQuote'd); zombie/gh-848 PATCH summaries (fixed literals); stderr-file paths (sanitized at creation). - DRY path unchanged (AC4): same `[dry] stamp …` log, no file, no command. ### How to verify ```bash dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json # stamp + hostile-string pins dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_checkRunStamp.json # transport unit tests (UT-1..3, E1, E2) dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json # full suite: 4760 passed, 0 failed ``` Real-shell spot check (reproduces the live bug and proves the fix): the old `-f summary="…(${{ matrix.os }})…"` form exits 2 with `Bad substitution` under dash; the new `--input` form posts the body byte-for-byte, and a shellQuote'd `--ref 'ai/g'\''h-50;$(touch /tmp/pwn)'` dispatch expands nothing.
Transport diagram ```mermaid flowchart TD SYNC[syncValidationChecks / validate_pr] --> STAMP[stampValidationChecksForModule] STAMP --> LB[stampLinkBlock jobs probe] LB --> BODY[checkRunStamp.buildCheckRunBody
E1: truncate summary at 65,535] BODY --> FW[file_write /tmp/sm-check-run-N.json] FW --> CLI[gh api -X POST repos/o/r/check-runs --input tmpfile
zero untrusted bytes] CLI --> DEL[file_delete in finally — success AND failure] CLI -->|throws| WARN[warn and skip — next check name] ```

# pr-1115: gh-1107 SM: check-run stamps fail with 'Bad substitution' — job names interpolated into shell string ## Description Closes #1107 ### What changed Check-run stamps no longer interpolate run-derived text into a shell string. `stampValidationChecksForModule` now builds the Checks-API request body as JSON (`{name, head_sha, status, conclusion?, details_url?, output:{title, summary}}`), writes it to a temp file, posts it with `gh api -X POST repos/{o}/{r}/check-runs --input `, and deletes the file in `finally`. A job named `Lockfile smoke (${{ matrix.os }} release)` therefore reaches dash only as JSON payload bytes — the command string carries zero untrusted bytes, so `Bad substitution` (exit 2, missing stamps, blocked PRs) cannot recur. Transport + helpers live in a new `js/common/checkRunStamp.js`. ### Key decisions - Temp-file JSON body (`--input`) instead of escaping: JSON preserves `${{ }}`, `$(id)`, backticks, `"`, `\`, newlines byte-for-byte (AC1); the same gh-960 PR-body precedent `scm.js` already uses. Only the fixed repo path and a digits-only `/tmp/sm-check-run--.json` path ever touch the shell (AC2). - Temp file deleted in `finally` — on success AND failure (AC3); an unwritable temp dir warns and skips exactly like the old failure mode (E2); summary > 65,535 chars truncates with a marker, never rejected (E1). - `stampLinkBlock` dropped its legacy `"` → `'` mangling — the body must be byte-for-byte, and quotes are safe inside JSON. - AC5 audit of `cli_execute_command` sites interpolating PR/run-derived text — all converted through ONE `shellQuote` (re-exported from `factory/token_usage.js` via `checkRunStamp.js`): - `dispatchCiWorkflow` `--ref ` (validate-arm CI dispatch) — was bare unquoted; - silent-update chain (classic): `--branch ` + push refspec — was bare; - silent-update chain (fork, gh-1070): `git checkout -B ` + `HEAD:` refspec — was bare; - gh-757 ghost dispatch — inline `'`-escaping normalized to the shared helper (byte-identical output); - gh-857 placeholder conclusion PATCH — `details_url` (run-derived URL) + `output[summary]` values now shellQuote'd; - gh-998 zombie-sweep PATCH — fixed-literal summary moved to the same helper so the shape cannot regress. - Audited and left as-is (no untrusted bytes): probe calls keyed on config `ciWorkflow`, hex head SHAs, numeric run/check-run ids; local-teammate runner (Jira key + config values); factory-state transport (already shellQuote'd); zombie/gh-848 PATCH summaries (fixed literals); stderr-file paths (sanitized at creation). - DRY path unchanged (AC4): same `[dry] stamp …` log, no file, no command. ### How to verify ```bash dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json # stamp + hostile-string pins dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_checkRunStamp.json # transport unit tests (UT-1..3, E1, E2) dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json # full suite: 4760 passed, 0 failed ``` Real-shell spot check (reproduces the live bug and proves the fix): the old `-f summary="…(${{ matrix.os }})…"` form exits 2 with `Bad substitution` under dash; the new `--input` form posts the body byte-for-byte, and a shellQuote'd `--ref 'ai/g'\''h-50;$(touch /tmp/pwn)'` dispatch expands nothing.
Transport diagram ```mermaid flowchart TD SYNC[syncValidationChecks / validate_pr] --> STAMP[stampValidationChecksForModule] STAMP --> LB[stampLinkBlock jobs probe] LB --> BODY[checkRunStamp.buildCheckRunBody
E1: truncate summary at 65,535] BODY --> FW[file_write /tmp/sm-check-run-N.json] FW --> CLI[gh api -X POST repos/o/r/check-runs --input tmpfile
zero untrusted bytes] CLI --> DEL[file_delete in finally — success AND failure] CLI -->|throws| WARN[warn and skip — next check name] ```

# pr-1115: gh-1107 SM: check-run stamps fail with 'Bad substitution' — job names interpolated into shell string ## Description Closes #1107 ### What changed Check-run stamps no longer interpolate run-derived text into a shell string. `stampValidationChecksForModule` now builds the Checks-API request body as JSON (`{name, head_sha, status, conclusion?, details_url?, output:{title, summary}}`), writes it to a temp file, posts it with `gh api -X POST repos/{o}/{r}/check-runs --input `, and deletes the file in `finally`. A job named `Lockfile smoke (${{ matrix.os }} release)` therefore reaches dash only as JSON payload bytes — the command string carries zero untrusted bytes, so `Bad substitution` (exit 2, missing stamps, blocked PRs) cannot recur. Transport + helpers live in a new `js/common/checkRunStamp.js`. ### Key decisions - Temp-file JSON body (`--input`) instead of escaping: JSON preserves `${{ }}`, `$(id)`, backticks, `"`, `\`, newlines byte-for-byte (AC1); the same gh-960 PR-body precedent `scm.js` already uses. Only the fixed repo path and a digits-only `/tmp/sm-check-run--.json` path ever touch the shell (AC2). - Temp file deleted in `finally` — on success AND failure (AC3); an unwritable temp dir warns and skips exactly like the old failure mode (E2); summary > 65,535 chars truncates with a marker, never rejected (E1). - `stampLinkBlock` dropped its legacy `"` → `'` mangling — the body must be byte-for-byte, and quotes are safe inside JSON. - AC5 audit of `cli_execute_command` sites interpolating PR/run-derived text — all converted through ONE `shellQuote` (re-exported from `factory/token_usage.js` via `checkRunStamp.js`): - `dispatchCiWorkflow` `--ref ` (validate-arm CI dispatch) — was bare unquoted; - silent-update chain (classic): `--branch ` + push refspec — was bare; - silent-update chain (fork, gh-1070): `git checkout -B ` + `HEAD:` refspec — was bare; - gh-757 ghost dispatch — inline `'`-escaping normalized to the shared helper (byte-identical output); - gh-857 placeholder conclusion PATCH — `details_url` (run-derived URL) + `output[summary]` values now shellQuote'd; - gh-998 zombie-sweep PATCH — fixed-literal summary moved to the same helper so the shape cannot regress. - Audited and left as-is (no untrusted bytes): probe calls keyed on config `ciWorkflow`, hex head SHAs, numeric run/check-run ids; local-teammate runner (Jira key + config values); factory-state transport (already shellQuote'd); zombie/gh-848 PATCH summaries (fixed literals); stderr-file paths (sanitized at creation). - DRY path unchanged (AC4): same `[dry] stamp …` log, no file, no command. ### How to verify ```bash dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json # stamp + hostile-string pins dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_checkRunStamp.json # transport unit tests (UT-1..3, E1, E2) dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json # full suite: 4760 passed, 0 failed ``` Real-shell spot check (reproduces the live bug and proves the fix): the old `-f summary="…(${{ matrix.os }})…"` form exits 2 with `Bad substitution` under dash; the new `--input` form posts the body byte-for-byte, and a shellQuote'd `--ref 'ai/g'\''h-50;$(touch /tmp/pwn)'` dispatch expands nothing.
Transport diagram ```mermaid flowchart TD SYNC[syncValidationChecks / validate_pr] --> STAMP[stampValidationChecksForModule] STAMP --> LB[stampLinkBlock jobs probe] LB --> BODY[checkRunStamp.buildCheckRunBody
E1: truncate summary at 65,535] BODY --> FW[file_write /tmp/sm-check-run-N.json] FW --> CLI[gh api -X POST repos/o/r/check-runs --input tmpfile
zero untrusted bytes] CLI --> DEL[file_delete in finally — success AND failure] CLI -->|throws| WARN[warn and skip — next check name] ```

A job named `Lockfile smoke (${{ matrix.os }} release)` therefore reaches dash only as JSON payload bytes — the command string carries zero untrusted bytes, so `Bad substitution` (exit 2, missing stamps, blocked PRs) cannot recur. Transport + helpers live in a new `js/common/checkRunStamp.js`. ### Key decisions - Temp-file JSON body (`--input`) instead of escaping: JSON preserves `${{ }}`, `$(id)`, backticks, `"`, `\`, newlines byte-for-byte (AC1); the same gh-960 PR-body precedent `scm.js` already uses. # pr-1115: gh-1107 SM: check-run stamps fail with 'Bad substitution' — job names interpolated into shell string ## Description Closes #1107 ### What changed Check-run stamps no longer interpolate run-derived text into a shell string. `stampValidationChecksForModule` now builds the Checks-API request body as JSON (`{name, head_sha, status, conclusion?, details_url?, output:{title, summary}}`), writes it to a temp file, posts it with `gh api -X POST repos/{o}/{r}/check-runs --input `, and deletes the file in `finally`. A job named `Lockfile smoke (${{ matrix.os }} release)` therefore reaches dash only as JSON payload bytes — the command string carries zero untrusted bytes, so `Bad substitution` (exit 2, missing stamps, blocked PRs) cannot recur. Transport + helpers live in a new `js/common/checkRunStamp.js`. ### Key decisions - Temp-file JSON body (`--input`) instead of escaping: JSON preserves `${{ }}`, `$(id)`, backticks, `"`, `\`, newlines byte-for-byte (AC1); the same gh-960 PR-body precedent `scm.js` already uses.
